items.t: 10-speed transmission damage can lock the wheels (recall)
items.note: If damage is already found, ask whether the transmission repair is covered under the recall or powertrain warranty.

items.t: Harsh shifts and shudder from a cracked 10-speed valve body
items.note: Estimate. If the transmission itself is damaged, a replacement can run $3,000-$6,000.

items.t: Rough shifting, hesitation or slipping from the 8-speed automatic
items.job: Transmission fluid service and software update, torque converter if needed
items.note: Estimate. The low end is a fluid service; the high end is a torque converter replacement. A full transmission is $3,000-$6,000.

items.t: Shudder at light throttle from the 8-speed automatic
items.job: Transmission fluid flush and refill with updated fluid
items.note: GM has covered this flush on many cars; ask a dealer with your VIN.

items.t: Loss of power, stalling or reduced engine power
items.job: Diagnose and repair loss of power (sensor, wiring or boost control part)
items.note: Estimate; cost depends on the cause found.

items.t: Front passenger seat belt anchor bolt may be missing (recall)
Child seat anchors blocked by excess adhesive (recall)
items.job: Remove excess adhesive from child seat anchors (recall)

items.t: Rear seat belts may not lock to hold a child seat (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace rear seat belt retractors (recall)

items.t: Stability control and ABS can switch off without warning (recall)
Turn signal does not cancel after a turn (recall)
Tire pressure warning may not work with dealer-installed 20-inch wheels (recall)
Water leaking into the trunk and damaging the audio amplifier
items.job: Find and reseal trunk leak, replace water-damaged amplifier
items.note: Estimate. Sealing the leak alone costs much less than replacing wet electronics.

items.t: Check engine light from a broken EVAP vapor line
items.job: Replace EVAP vapor line, purge valve or canister
items.note: RepairPal lists $143-$200 for a purge valve and $372-$440 for an EVAP canister on the CT6.

items.t: Brake grinding or rattling noises and poor brake feel
Super Cruise will not engage or keeps shutting off
items.job: Software and map update, camera check
items.note: Estimate; often covered under warranty or done over the air.

items.t: Rattles and odd noises inside the cabin
items.job: Locate and secure loose trim or heat shield

items.t: A/C does not cool when the car is remote started
items.job: Check remote start settings and update software
